main_body: Steampunk factory hall: a large corrugated grey-blue metal roof slope (rows ~28-90) over a dark brick front wall with arched windows and a riveted double door (rows ~92-126). A brick chimney stands on the right.
top_band: At the centre column: a dark back edge at rows 28-29, a light grey ridge band at rows 29-31, a vent rail at rows 32-35, then the corrugated roof slope in mid grey-blue at rows 36-89. An orange eave strip at rows 90-92 ends the roof and the brick face starts below it.
evidence: The roof is a large sloped surface seen from above, with a ridge and a skylight rail. It ends in a distinct orange eave line, and a dark shadow row sits under it on the brick wall. The brick face below has arched windows with sills and a door set into a frame. The roof and the wall are clearly separate surfaces. The roof takes the same role as the references' large tile roofs, so it reads as a top slope and not a thin rim.

style.evidence: The roof has about 5 grey-blue steps with corrugation stripes, rust speckles and skylight glazing. The brick has 3-4 tones with mortar variation. The window glass and the glowing lit panes add colour variety. The outlines are tinted dark blue-grey or brown and lean towards the neighbouring material, not neutral black. The corrugated roof is somewhat regular and the door panel is smooth, but there are no large flat fills. Overall it sits acceptably next to the references, slightly less rich than the tile roofs.
